name: editor-bridge
summary: Keep one editor open and call it from the shell: run Python in it, call any editor tool, capture a viewport image.
adapt: Add .gam3/editor.json to .gitignore (it holds the running editor's PID). Keep .gam3/lock.json in git.
Run `node Tools/gam3/ue_mcp.mjs toolsets` once and note which toolsets your engine version offers; pass the ones you need to `ue_editor.mjs start --toolsets`.

verified.how: ue_editor.mjs start waited for the editor and reported ready; status showed the port holder; stop ended that editor and left the port free. ue_mcp.mjs toolsets, py (a value back, and a Python error back with exit 1) and shot (PNG saved) all ran. UE 5.8 and Windows were not run.
